channel.title: AI News Digest
channel.description: Official AI product updates from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and GitHub

item.title: A scorecard for the AI age
item.description: Sarah Friar, CFO of OpenAI, introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.

item.title: Repository-level GitHub Copilot usage metrics generally available
item.description: The Copilot usage metrics REST API now reports repository-level activity. Two new endpoints return a daily, per-repository breakdown of pull request activity for Copilot coding agent and Copilot code review.

item.title: GitHub Mobile: Fix pull request comments with Copilot cloud agent
item.description: You can now select Fix with Copilot directly from Copilot code review pull request comments in GitHub Mobile. The button is available both on the pull request’s main view and on individual review comments, giving you multilpe ways to start a Copilot-assisted fix.

item.title: GitHub Copilot app now available in the usage metrics API
item.description: The Copilot usage metrics API now reports the GitHub Copilot app usage in the enterprise and organization 1-day and 28-day reports. This gives enterprise and organization admins visibility into the app’s activity alongside the IDE, chat, code review, and coding agent metrics they already retrieve.

item.title: Copilot code review: Customization and configurability improvements
item.description: Copilot code review now utilizes a firewall, custom setup steps, and independent runner configurations. It now reads custom instructions from the head branch to allow for easy testing and validation of custom instructions.

item.title: Why teens deserve access to safe AI
item.description: Learn how OpenAI is making ChatGPT safer for teens with age-appropriate protections, learning tools, parental controls, and expert partnerships.

item.title: How Cars24 scales conversations and builds faster with OpenAI
item.description: Cars24 uses OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to handle 1M+ monthly conversation minutes, recover 12% of lost leads, and bring agentic workflows to teams across the company.

item.title: Create, edit and star in videos with two Google Vids updates
item.description: Gemini Omni and personal avatars in Google Vids make video creation easier than ever.

item.title: Connect more of your apps to Search
item.description: You’ll be able to securely link and interact with your go-to services directly in AI Mode.

item.title: GPT-Red: Unlocking Self-Improvement for Robustness
item.description: Explore GPT-Red, OpenAI’s automated red teaming system that uses self-play to improve AI safety, alignment, and prompt injection robustness.

item.title: The US is advancing AI safety through state and federal action
item.description: OpenAI outlines a “reverse federalism” approach to AI governance, where state laws help build a national framework for safe, democratic AI.

item.title: Improvements to secret scanning and public monitoring
item.description: This week, we’re rolling out several improvements to secret scanning and public monitoring: Resend is now a GitHub secret scanning partner. Secret scanning now detects new secret types from APIclub and Resend.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — June update
item.description: June 2026 is about visibility and trust with a clearer view of your GitHub Copilot usage, a new trust layer for MCP servers, and the first C++ scenarios for the modernization agent reaching general availability. Highlights Here’s what’s new with GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio 2026.

item.title: Mid-conversation system messages
item.description: Mid-conversation system messages are available on Claude Fable 5, Claude Mythos 5, and Claude Opus 4.8, on the Claude API, Claude in Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud. No beta header is required. This corrects earlier availability notes.

item.title: Security reviews now available in the GitHub Copilot app
item.description: You can now run a security review on your in-flight code changes directly from the GitHub Copilot app. The /security-review slash command is shipping in public preview, bringing the same AI-driven vulnerability scanning already available in Copilot CLI into your everyday coding workflow.

item.title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains expands BYOK capabilities
item.description: This update brings major advances in customization and model provider flexibility to all tiers of GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs. With richer plugin and provider experiences, improved conversational interactions, and stronger reliability, teams can more confidently tailor Copilot to how they build software.

item.title: Code scanning shows AI security detections on pull requests
item.description: GitHub code scanning now surfaces AI-powered security detections directly on pull requests, expanding vulnerability coverage to languages and frameworks not currently supported by CodeQL. These detections help teams identify and address potential issues in parts of the codebase that previously had no native scanning coverage, all before code is merged.

item.title: Introducing Claude for Teachers
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Anthropic commits $10 million to Canadian AI research
item.description: Anthropic is committing $10M to Canadian research institutions to fund the next generation of AI research.

item.title: Claude Enterprise
item.description: You can now manage the people in your Claude Enterprise (claude.ai) organization with the Admin API, in beta for all Claude Enterprise organizations: list members and look them up by email address, change a member's role, remove members, send and withdraw invites, manage groups and their membership, and read custom roles. Group and custom-role requests require the anthropic-beta: ce-user-management-2026-07-13 beta header; member and invite requests take no beta header.

item.title: GitHub Code Quality license estimate in public preview
item.description: You can now see the number of active committers on repositories using GitHub Code Quality across your enterprise, giving you an estimate of your Code Quality license cost before it becomes a paid product on July 20, 2026. Code Quality is free during the public preview, so this usage isn’t billed today.

item.title: How Deutsche Telekom is rewiring telecommunications with AI
item.description: How Deutsche Telekom is becoming an AI-native telco with OpenAI-transforming customer service, employee workflows, network operations, and the future of voice.

item.title: GitHub Mobile: Improved filters and sorting for Copilot sessions
item.description: GitHub Mobile now includes improved filters and sorting for Copilot sessions, making it easier to find the right session as your session list grows. You can now narrow your session list using lightweight filters designed for mobile, including: Active (non-archived) Status Repository Type Agent Sort These controls help you quickly find sessions that are active, completed, need your attention, or are associated with a specific repository or session type.

item.title: CodeQL 2.26.0 adds Kotlin 2.4.0 support and AI prompt injection detection
item.description: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code. We’ve recently released CodeQL 2.26.0, which adds support for Kotlin 2.4.0, introduces a JavaScript and TypeScript query for system prompt injection, and improves analysis accuracy across multiple languages.

item.title: Clearer names for secret scanning detector types
item.description: To make secret scanning easier to understand, we’re updating the names we use for our detector types to better reflect how each one finds secrets. This is a naming change only; detection behavior is exactly the same.

item.title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts in public preview
item.description: Agentic autofix is now in public preview for all code scanning alerts. It remediates alerts generated by CodeQL and third-party scanning tools by working across your codebase the way a developer would—it explores relevant files, proposes a fix, and reruns the original analysis to confirm the fix closes the alert before opening a pull request for your review.

item.title: Dreams
item.description: Dreams (research preview) now supports Claude Fable 5 and Claude Sonnet 5. See Supported models.

item.title: cmek_preserve
item.description: We've expanded the Access Transparency documentation of cmek_preserve events with a filter example, an example event payload, and two preservation reason codes ( policy_violation_investigation, csae_report ). The documentation now also clarifies that a preservation event is written whether the preservation was initiated by a human reviewer or an automated safety pipeline. See CMEK content preservation.

item.title: GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Learn how GPT-5.6 powers Microsoft 365 Copilot with stronger AI capabilities across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Chat, and Cowork for faster, higher-quality work.

item.title: GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
item.description: More intelligence from every token, stronger performance per dollar, and more capability on demand for your hardest work.

item.title: ChatGPT is now a partner for your most ambitious work
item.description: ChatGPT Work is an agent that can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.

item.title: GPT-5.6 model family
item.description: Released the GPT-5.6 model family, including GPT-5.6 Sol for frontier capability, GPT-5.6 Terra for a balance of intelligence and cost, and GPT-5.6 Luna for efficient, high-volume workloads. The gpt-5.6 alias routes requests to gpt-5.6-sol.

item.title: GPT-5.5 Bio Bug Bounty
item.description: Details about the OpenAI Bio Bounty program

item.title: OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna are now available in GitHub Copilot
item.description: OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 family is now rolling out in GitHub Copilot. GPT-5.6 comes in three variants, Sol, Terra, and Luna, so you can match the model to the job, whether that’s reasoning over a large codebase, everyday agentic coding, or fast, cost-efficient assistance.

item.title: New pull requests dashboard is now generally available
item.description: The refreshed pull requests dashboard is now generally available at github.com/pulls. It gives you a single home to track, prioritize, and act on the pull requests that need your attention, whether you’re an individual contributor or a manager working across many teams and projects.

item.title: Ask Copilot for a repository overview
item.description: You can now ask GitHub Copilot for a high-level overview of any repository you’re exploring for the first time. When you visit the home page of a repository you haven’t contributed to before on github.com, Copilot offers to generate an overview for you.

item.title: UST is bringing Claude to physical AI
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: A new way to reflect on how you use Claude
item.description: Introducing a new way to reflect on and refine how you use Claude. It lets you easily track and visualize how you use Claude, and decide whether that time aligns with your goals.

item.title: Inviting hard questions
item.description: We're asking the public for their hardest questions about AI, and committing to show our work as we address them.

item.title: Ben Bernanke appointed to Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations
item.description: A new analysis from OpenAI reveals issues in SWE-Bench Pro, a popular coding benchmark, raising concerns about reliability and accuracy in evaluating AI models.

item.title: Helping K–12 educators build practical AI skills
item.description: OpenAI Academy and the Walton Family Foundation are bringing hands-on AI Skills Jams to help K–12 educators build practical AI skills for the classroom.

item.title: Introducing GPT-Live
item.description: A new generation of voice models for natural human-AI interaction, now powering ChatGPT Voice.

item.title: Our approach to government and national security partnerships
item.description: Learn how OpenAI approaches government and national security partnerships, with principles for responsible AI use, democratic accountability, and public safety.

item.title: GitHub Mobile: Live notifications for Copilot CLI sessions
item.description: Live coding agent notifications on GitHub Mobile now support remote Copilot CLI sessions, making it easier to stay connected to agent work that starts outside of GitHub Mobile. When a Copilot CLI session is running remotely, GitHub Mobile can surface real-time updates directly on your phone so you can track progress, know when the agent needs your input, and jump back into the session when needed.

item.title: GitHub Mobile: Fix merge conflicts with Copilot cloud agent
item.description: GitHub Mobile now supports fixing pull request merge conflicts with Copilot cloud agent, making it easier to unblock pull requests while you’re on the go. When a pull request has merge conflicts, you can now start the Copilot workflow directly from the pull request merge box on mobile.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code, June 2026 releases
item.description: This changelog covers VS Code v1.123 through v1.127, shipped throughout June and early July 2026. The latest VS Code releases build on the Copilot experience developers use every day, making it easier to manage agent work, understand usage, choose the right models, and stay in the flow.

item.title: Enterprise-managed OpenTelemetry export for VS Code and CLI
item.description: Organizations can now mandate where GitHub Copilot sends OpenTelemetry (OTel) data, so telemetry flows to an approved collector without each developer setting OTEL_* environment variables. The configuration is delivered through the telemetry block in enterprise-managed settings and applies to both the Copilot Chat extension in VS Code and the agent host process that powers Copilot CLI.

item.title: Deploy managed Copilot settings via MDM in VS Code and CLI
item.description: Enterprise administrators can now deliver managed GitHub Copilot settings directly to devices through native mobile device management (MDM) and file-based configuration, in addition to the existing server-managed channel. This is generally available for GitHub Copilot CLI and VS Code.

item.title: Kimi K2.7 now available for Copilot Business and Enterprise
item.description: On July 1, 2026, we announced Kimi K2.7 would be available to Copilot Pro, Pro+, and Max plans. The model is now additionally available on Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise plans.
